Description: While active, a portion of the [Physical] [Attack] damage you deal is stored. Casting a [Spell] uses the stored damage to create a patch of [ThornyGround|Thorny Ground] that deals [Spell] damage to moving enemies.
While active, you constantly regenerate [Rage].

ShortDescription: Enter a bestial frenzy but constantly lose Life.

Description: While active, your Fury builds from [Attack|Attacking] enemies. Using this Skill releases your Fury to send you into a bestial frenzy, gaining damage and [Onslaught] but constantly losing life and forcing you into animal form. The frenzy ends immediately if you return to human form. You cannot gain Fury while in a frenzy.
This skill is [Trigger|Triggered] when Predator's Mark [MarkActivate|Activates] to Summon a Wolf [Minion] that follows you as long as it lives.

Build [Glory] by gaining [Rage] while already at maximum [Rage]. When you have maximum [Glory], roar to the heavens to bring them down upon your enemies. For the duration of the Skill, meteors rain down around you and you [Gain] [Fire] damage and [Rage] regeneration. This Skill's effects are suppressed if you leave [Bear] form, but will resume if you return to [Bear] form before the duration expires.
ShortDescription: Build [Glory] in [Bear] form, then call down meteors around you for a sustained duration.

Description: Leash the stars themselves by leveraging your vast magical power, repeatedly [Trigger|Triggering] Starfall targeting an enemy in an area around you, or a random location in that area if no enemies can be targeted.
ShortDescription: Call to the stars using sheer magical power to rain down Verisium comets around you.

Description: A star falls at a targeted location, dealing area damage on impact. Larger stars leave [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground] for a short duration.

Build [Glory] by [Hit|Hitting] enemies with [ElementalDamage|Elemental] damage. When you have maximum [Glory], you may become the walking Apocalypse for a duration, [Trigger|Triggering] one of multiple powerful [ElementalDamage|Elemental] Skills at an interval while this [Buff] lasts.
ShortDescription: Build [Glory] and become a walking Apocalypse, wielding the [ElementalDamage|Elements] themselves against your enemies.

Description: Targets an area or an enemy, calling down a massive meteor to strike an area, dealing [Fire] damage and contributing to your enemies' extinction.
ShortDescription: Call down a powerful meteor.

Description: Targets an area or an enemy, causing a series of icy hailstones to rain down in an area over a duration.
ShortDescription: Rain down a series of icy hailstones in an area to deal significant [Cold] damage.

Description: Targets an area or an enemy, causing a rapid buildup of pulsing [Lightning] damage in an area that culminates in a powerful final [Lightning] strike.
ShortDescription: Unleash a series of pulses, culminating in a powerful [Lightning] strike.

Description: Spawn a verdant flower that grows and explodes.
Causes a fiery explosion in a cone behind the target, dealing [Attack] damage which is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]
Sends a [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] [Projectile] from the [Shock|Shocked] enemy towards a nearby Drenched enemy, dealing [Spell] damage.

Mirrors of Refraction appear in your [Presence] periodically. [Hit|Hitting] a mirror with a [Spell] [Projectile] causes it to shatter, copying the projectiles in a nova around the destroyed mirror. Copied [Projectile|Projectiles] may be copied again when colliding with other mirrors.

While active, taking [Hit] damage from enemies to your [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] causes you to gain [Armour] for a short duration. [Armour] gained from multiple [Hit|Hits] can stack. The total [Armour] gained from this Skill cannot exceed the [ItemArmour|Item Armour] on your [EquipArmour|Equipped Armour Items].

While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you spend Mana. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to create visages which attack once with a socketed [Shapeshift|Shapeshifting] [Attack], creating multiple visages if it has enough [Energy].

Attach a Toxic Pustule to the enemy, which [DetonationTime|Detonates] after a delay, dealing [Attack] damage. They can also be [Poison|Poisoned], causing them to [DetonationTime|Detonate] faster and more violently.
Creates a deadly slash towards the target, dealing [Attack] damage which is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon].
Build [Glory] by dealing [Chaos] damage to enemies. When you have maximum [Glory], you can entreat the Dreamer to inhabit you, briefly becoming his [Archon].
You are chosen by Azmerian spirits who provide guidance, allowing you to see nearby [AncientBlooms|Ancient Blooms].
ShortDescription: Azmerian spirits offer guidance, allowing you to see nearby [AncientBlooms|Ancient Blooms].

Description: Leap into the air carried by divine wings, damaging enemies with your spear where you land. If there is a [DivineFragment|Fragment of Divinity] near you or the targeted location, this attack will [Consume] it when you leap to become [Empowered], dealing more damage and granting life and mana recovery. This skill does not use up its Cooldown when empowered.
ShortDescription: Leap into the air carried by divinity, damaging enemies with your spear where you land.

Description: Build up Glory by [Freeze|Freezing] or [Chill|Chilling] enemies. When you have maximum [Glory] you may jump backwards loosing your [Mace] with the force of a falling comet onto your target. The impact releases [MoltenFissure|Fissures] and causes stars to fall in the area for a brief period.
ShortDescription: Build [Glory], then loose your [Mace] like a comet to create fissures and call down the stars on your enemies.

Description: While active, summons short-lived Azmerian Swarms when you kill enemies affected by [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] or hit [Rarity|Rare or Unique] enemies affected by [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments]. The swarms are untargetable [Minion|Minions] that pursue nearby enemies to [Attack] them and inflict [FaerieFire|Faerie Fire] on [Hit].
Draws out the latent fears of enemies you kill and [Rarity|Rare] or [Rarity|Unique] enemies you [Hit], turning them into unstable apparitions which charge towards enemies and then explode.
The Flock damages enemies around you.

Hurl your [Shield] as a [Projectile] which [Return|Returns] to you at the end of its flight. While the [Shield] is in flight, this skill is replaced with Embrace the Fall. This skill's cooldown is skipped if you catch the [Shield] as it [Return|Returns], or destroy an [IceCrystals|Ice Crystal] with the Embrace the Fall.
ShortDescription: Hurl your [Shield] outward which [Return|Returns] at the end of its flight.

Description: Teleport to your thrown [Shield], appearing in the air and [Slam|Slamming] it into the ground to deal damage in an area. Destroying an [IceCrystals|Ice Crystal] with this skill skips the cooldown of Soaring Midnight.
ShortDescription: To teleport to your [Shield] and perform a flying shield [Slam].

Description: Conjure a [Chaos] tornado that chases down and [Slow|Slows] enemies.
Summons a [Shapeshift|Shapeshifting] Spirit Vessel [Companion] that uses copies of socketed [Bear], [Werewolf], and [Wyvern] Skills.
Direct your feline companion to mesmerize another player's pet.
ShortDescription: Direct your feline companion to mesmerize another player's pet.

Description: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them, [CullingStrike|Culling] enemies if their life is low enough. When this skill kills an enemy you draw out their final fears, crushing them to create a shockwave. Enemies around you that can be [CullingStrike|Culled] will be highlighted.
ShortDescription: Dash to an enemy and kill near-death enemies to draw out their final fears.

Description: While active, [Critical] [Hit|Hits] with other skills that kill targets, or hit powerful targets cause you to gain Arctic Petals. Once you have enough Arctic Petals they will be [Consume|Consumed] to create [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] near the most recent target.
While active, conjures a glittering barrier that accumulates protective gemstone Motes of each [Attributes|Attribute] type over time, but loses a random Mote when you are [Hit].
Explodes a Witchtoad to deal spell damage in an area.

While active, areas of intense runic energy are revealed to you. Standing over them grants you a powerful [Spell] damage boost but constantly drains your [Ward|Runic Ward]. Running out of [Ward|Runic Ward] causes the energy to temporarily dissipate.

Unleash a wave of volatile ice that feeds on flames. While the wave doesn't deal damage, the ice latches onto [Ignite|Ignited] enemies, refreshing the duration of their active [Ignite] and rapidly [Freeze|Freezing] them but preventing them from being [Ignite|Ignited] further until the [Ignite] expires.
ShortDescription: Unleash a wave of volatile ice that causes rapid [Freeze] buildup on [Ignite|Ignited] enemies.

Description: Sacrifice your [Ward|Runic Ward] to send out an energy pulse that grants nearby [Allies] [Guard].
ShortDescription: Sacrifice your [Ward|Runic Ward] to grant nearby [Allies] [Guard].

Description: Fires molten [Projectile|Projectiles] from the enemy hit, which will explode when they land nearby, dealing [Attack] damage in an area.
ShortDescription: Fires molten [Projectile|Projectiles].

Description: Spends [Ward] to generate [VerisiumInfusion|Verisium Infusions], which can be used in place of any [ElementalInfusion|Elemental Infusions].
ShortDescription: Generate [VerisiumInfusion|Verisium Infusions], which can be used in place of any [ElementalInfusion|Elemental Infusion].

Description: Spends all your [Ward|Runic Ward] to gain a short-duration [Buff] that causes you to [Block] all [Block|Blockable] [Hit|Hits] and apply [ParriedDebuff|Parried] to enemies from which you've [Block|Blocked] a [Hit]. This [Buff] is removed if you are [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned]. While this [Buff] is active, you cannot be [LightStun|Light Stunned], but [Block|Blocking] too much damage may [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] you.
ShortDescription: Gain a [Buff] that causes you to [Block] [Hit|Hits] and apply [ParriedDebuff|Parried] to enemies you [Block].

Description: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to [Curse] enemies with a Verisium Rune, inflicting them with Fragility. [Hit|Hitting] these enemies removes the [Curse] to [Trigger] an explosion, [Knockback|Knocking Back] nearby enemies and causing more [Stun] buildup based on the Fragility on the target [Hit].
ShortDescription: [Curse] enemies in an area, which causes explosions and [Knockback|Knocks Back] other nearby enemies if [Curse|Cursed] targets [Hit].

Description: Deals [Physical] [Attack] damage in an area around the [Curse|Cursed] target that is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]'s damage. Other targets are [Knockback|Knocked back] and take more [Stun] buildup based on the Fragility they have.
ShortDescription: Deal significant damage to the target and nearby enemies, applying [Knockback|Knockback] to all other targets.

Description: Tap into the power of the Triskelion Flame to [Empowered|Empower] the next [Cascadable|Cascadable] [Spell] you cast. The [Empowered] [Spell] becomes centred on your location, and [Cascadable|Cascades] to six areas around you in a Triskelion pattern.
ShortDescription: [Empowered|Empower] the next [Cascadable|Cascadable] [Spell] you cast to target multiple areas around you.

Description: [DNT] Gain stack of cleansed and corrupted forms when attacking with a bow.
ShortDescription: [DNT] Shoot bow gain stacks.

Description: {DNT] Swap the currently dominant form of the Cradle of Conflict.
ShortDescription: [DNT] Swap quiver forms.

Description: Build [Glory] by spending [Ward|Runic Ward]. When you have maximum [Glory], you may call down a mass of Verisium from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location and summoning a [TemporaryMinion|Temporary Minion]. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. [Consume|Consumes] a [VerisiumInfusion|Verisium Infusion], if possible, to increase the number of [TemporaryMinion|Minions] summoned.
ShortDescription: Build [Glory] by spending [Ward|Runic Ward], then drop a mass of Verisium on the target and summon a [TemporaryMinion|Temporary Minion].

Description: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to cause a destabilising [Hit] against an enemy under the [CullingStrike|Culling Strike Threshold], making them violently explode. Highlights enemies under the [CullingStrike|Culling Strike Threshold].
ShortDescription: [Hit] an enemy under the [CullingStrike|Culling Strike Threshold] to cause them to explode, damaging nearby enemies.

Description: [Sacrifice] a portion of your Life to recover [Ward|Runic Ward]. [Ward|Runic Ward] recovered by this Skill can [Overflow].
ShortDescription: [Sacrifice] a portion of your Life to recover [Ward|Runic Ward]. [Ward|Runic Ward] recovered by this Skill can [Overflow].

Description: Spend [Ward] and target an area, transforming [Corpse|Corpses] into bitter cores that seek out enemies and [Chill] enemies near them. The cores explode at the end of their duration, creating runes which deal additional [Cold] damage over time.
ShortDescription: Transform [Corpse|Corpses] into bitter cores that seek out enemies and [Chill] them before exploding, creating runes which deal additional [Cold] damage over time.

Description: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to instantly [Reviving|Revive] your [Minion|Minions]. Prioritises the most powerful minions first.
ShortDescription: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to [Reviving|Revive] your [Minion|Minions].

ShortDescription: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to cause damaging [IceCrystals|Ice-Crystal] spears to erupt from the ground around you. These spears can be destroyed for an explosion of [Cold] damage.

Enemies will not directly engage these [Minion|Minions], and can pass through them.

Description: Summon a short-lived [TemporaryMinion|Verisium Manifestation] that launches [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] at enemies.

ShortDescription: While active, enemies you [Stun] or kill have a chance to generate a [Ward|Runic Ward] [Remnant]. These [Remnant|Remnants] can [Overflow] your [Ward|Runic Ward].

ShortDescription: Spend all your [Ward|Runic Ward] to summon [TemporaryMinion|Temporary] Wardbound Casters. These [Minion|Minions] target nearby enemies with damaging [Cold] [Spell|Spells].

ShortDescription: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to create a Verisium volcano that deals damage on intial eruption and [Trigger|Triggers] [IceFragment|Ice Fragments].

This damage is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon Damage], but is based on their accumulated [BloodLoss|Blood Loss]. The explosion destroys their [Corpse] if the enemy was [Rarity|Normal or Magic].

This Skill's cost is equal to the total cost of Socketed Skills. The copy cannot perform [Channelling|Channelled], [Remote], Cooldown or [Conditional] Skills, or summon [Minion|Minions].

Description: [Channelling|Channel] to create a protective bubble all around you, [Block|Blocking] [Hit|Hits] against you. While [Channelling] this Skill, you cannot be [LightStun|Light Stunned] by [Hit|Hits] you [Block], and damage you take from [Hit|Hits] is also removed from [Ward|Runic Ward]. [Block|Blocking] [Hit|Hits] this way causes you to accumulate [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup. You cannot recover [Ward|Runic Ward] while this Skill is active.
ShortDescription: [Channelling|Channel] to [Block] [Hit|Hits] against you at the cost of [Ward|Runic Ward].

Description: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to raise a pair of electrified pylons in front of you which project a wall of electricity between them, damaging and [Electrocute|Electrocuting] enemies caught between them. [Projectile|Projectiles] you fire through the wall become energised, and discharge that energy on [Hit] as [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] beams.
ShortDescription: Create a wall of electricity that [Electrocute|Electrocutes] enemies and energises your [Projectile|Projectiles].

Description: Creates a Fractured Mimic of yourself, suspended in time at the point of casting the [Trigger|Triggering] [Spell]. If you reach the [Limit] of Fractured Mimics, they will all finish casting their [Spell|Spells] and disappear.
While active, picking up [Remnant|Remnants] [Trigger|Triggers] a deadly explosion, dealing damage at the location of the [Remnant] based on the type of [Remnant] picked up.
ShortDescription: While active, picking up [Remnant|Remnants] [Trigger|Triggers] a deadly explosion, dealing damage at the location of the [Remnant] based on the type of [Remnant] picked up.

ShortDescription: Pour your [Ward|Runic Ward] into conjured blades which fall on enemies [Hit] by your [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks].

Description: Blows strong enough to [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] an enemy reverberate in an area around the enemy and heavily [ArmourBreak|Break Armour].

While active, Sprinting turns you into a locust swarm which deals [Physical] [Attack] damage, which is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]'s damage, in an area around you. You take damage and gain [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup if this [Hit|Hits] any targets, but damage you take from other sources while sprinting will not apply [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] or interrupt your sprinting.
